quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the team's resilience after trailing by 22 points
quotes.excerpt: we cannot overlook the fact that we were down 22 to the Celtics and came back
quotes.quote: I will comment quickly. I mean, I would say we made some plays, but we cannot overlook the fact that we were down 22 to the Celtics and came back and took the lead. I am way more focused on that. We put ourselves in a position to win the game. The resilience, the fight that our guys had in the second half, the defensive intensity, the ball movement, obviously we started making some shots, but just the energy, the life was there. Our guys responded to halftime down 20 plus in a very tough environment against a team that was playing extremely well. A lot of growth, a lot of progress here, and we will figure out how to close out a game.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins praised the resilience of his team after overcoming a 22 point deficit against the Celtics. He noted the second half defensive intensity and ball movement as key signs of growth for the group.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses the team's resilience after overcoming a 22-point deficit against the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the importance of collective ball movement and sharing the rock
quotes.excerpt: I just kept telling the team all game, stay connected. We are playing collective basketball together.
quotes.quote: I just kept telling the team all game, stay connected. We are playing collective basketball together. What you are doing on offense, we need to share the rock. We talked about it at halftime. We had I think only 14 made shots, 11 of them were assisted, and we had plenty of other potential assists. But when we were not playing to their hands, they were doing a great job. When we were moving, shifting on one side, when we started getting to the second side in the second half, we were getting open looks, we were able to penetrate the defense a little bit more, had a little bit more rhythm. So there is something to it. 28 assists when we only had 11 at halftime, but then we backed it up with some defensive intensity.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins emphasized the importance of ball movement after the team recorded 28 assists. He noted that shifting the defense and getting to the second side was critical to finding rhythm in the second half.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins explains the importance of ball movement and team chemistry during the postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the offensive contributions of Ryan, Jaime, Tyler, and Miles
quotes.excerpt: It was great to see Ryan have a great game there, a lot of different guys knocking shots.
quotes.quote: The ball always is going to find energy. Hopefully it leads to a spark for us. It was great to see Ryan have a great game there, a lot of different guys knocking shots. Jaime has been shooting the ball well, Tyler with big shots, Miles knocking down his shots as well. But we were playing connected. We were finding our guys open. When they were in drop coverage, we were picking and popping, we were touching the paint, slowing down, letting the defense be aggressive and finding the open windows. Hopefully this is a springboard for us. I just kept telling the guys just continue to trust. Continue to trust the work that you are putting in.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins highlighted the contributions of Ryan, Jaime, Tyler, and Miles in the comeback win. He credited their ability to stay connected and trust the work they are putting in as a potential springboard for the team.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins praises the offensive contributions of several players following the game.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on the playmaking and chemistry between Miles and Tyler
quotes.excerpt: Miles had six assists. So when you talk about being a hub, he plays on selfish.
quotes.quote: They are great. You look at it, Miles had six assists. So when you talk about being a hub, I know he could have had even more. He plays on selfish when he needs to be aggressive and he is open. We tell him to let it fly. He and I talked about that the other day. And then obviously when Tyler is moving off the ball and cutting, they are going to put their best defender on him every single night. How do we get him into aggressive spots, scoring spots for him? But he can just find a way. And when he knows he has teammates around him, he has Miles out there, guys he can trust and space off of, that is something hopefully that we can continue to build and just click with.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins praised the chemistry between Miles and Tyler. He noted that Miles is playing unselfishly as a hub and that the team is learning how to get Tyler into aggressive scoring spots while maintaining spacing.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses the playmaking chemistry between Miles and Tyler during his postgame media availability.
